stepTitle: 1. Which of these games do you have?
footnote: Both demo versions and full versions can work, but they have to be Switch 1 versions.
disclaimer: Current permission-elevation exploits only work on firmware 23.0.1. Some applications can still do userland-only things on other firmware versions, but full privilege escalation is not available there.

games.label: SmileBasic 4
games.subQuestion: Do you have the payload? (bootstrap.bas file) already setup on SmileBasic 4?
games.missingText: You need to obtain the payload (bootstrap.bas file) before proceeding. You can research about automatic writing methods using a Modded Switch 1, Raspberry Pico, Apple Silicon Mac, Android Device, SteamDeck and other methods. The one that fits your convenience, writing the payload manually is virtually impossible unless you have extreme calm.

games.label: Seedsow Lullaby (Full/Demo)
games.versionQuestion: Do you have the demo or the full version?

versionDisclaimer.demo: You have the demo version. The demos are the ones currently being worked on because they are more accessible, so this is the version you want.
versionDisclaimer.full: You have the full version. It might be supported in the future, but currently only the demo versions are being worked on, so payloads could come out for the full version later. Having the demo version is encouraged.

games.subQuestion: Do you have a modded save setup on your console?

payloadStatus.label: Payload status
payloadStatus.text: A working launcher is available for the supported demos, but there is still no payload for permission escalation (no FS payload).

games.missingTitle: You need a modded save setup first
games.missingText: You need to set up a modded save on your console before proceeding. To do this, you need a modded Switch 1 which allows you to manipulate your save, and transfer it to your Switch 2 console.

games.optionLabel: No, I don't have any of these.
games.blockedTitle: You need at least one of the required apps
games.blockedText: You need to obtain at least one of the required apps before proceeding. This is necessary to run the payloads and take advantage of the capabilities described above. If you don't do that you'll have to wait to see if another app accessible to you becomes available allowing you to run arbitrary code, and then just wait for a valid payload. Make sure to get the demo versions if available, and for Civilization 7 get the Switch 1 version on a physical cartridge.
